title: The pup's ear
logline: Close on the pup from behind: one ear up, turned toward the light between the trunks, the fur lit on that side only. The page is the ear.

panels.composition: Close on a small three-legged dog from behind with one ear raised and turned toward a warm light between cedar trunks ahead, the fur lit on that side only.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, close on a small three-legged dog seen from behind with one ear raised toward a warm light between cedar trunks ahead and its fur lit on that side only, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
